diagnosis: The view downloads a confidential document attached to a Wagtail Page. It never evaluates Wagtail's page permissions (page.permissions_for_user(request.user).can_view_revisions() or active page restrictions), letting any logged-in user download restricted documents attached to unviewable pages.
exploit_request:
GET /wagtail/pages/901/attachments/44/download/ HTTP/1.1
Host: portal.corp.example
Cookie: sessionid=attacker_session
